## Asana to Present at Upcoming Investor Events


September 4, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investors.asana.com/node/12246/pdf)


SAN FRANCISCO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 4, 2026-- Asana, Inc. (NYSE: ASAN)(LTSE: ASAN), the operating system for human-agent teams, today announced that Asana’s executives will present at the following investor events:


- Citi's 2026 Global TMT Conference on September 9, 2026 at 7:10 a.m. PT / 10:10 a.m. ET
- Piper Sandler Growth Frontiers Conference on September 15, 2026 at 11:30 a.m. PT / 2:30 p.m. ET


A live webcast will be available on Asana’s website at[https://investors.asana.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.asana.com&esheet=54599052&newsitemid=20260904692519&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.asana.com&index=1&md5=dc727135692e7be3b5431bcd1c7b5f92) .


**About Asana**


Asana is the operating system for human-agent teams. Built on 18 years of foundational architecture, the enterprise Work Graph®, multiplayer collaboration, shared memory, and governance, it is exactly what the agentic era requires: a place where humans and agents run critical workflows together, on the same plan, toward the same goals — unlocking enterprise productivity. Learn more at[asana.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fasana.com%2F&esheet=54599052&newsitemid=20260904692519&lan=en-US&anchor=asana.com&index=2&md5=638011d09aeb848f95358af80ea82b73) .
